transcript.text: Before we go further on sound, I need to flag a critical delivery issue. I confirmed with the distribution platform's ingest engineer that delivery must be stereo at 48 kHz with mono compatibility — and binaural delivery will be rejected outright. This directly conflicts with the binaural audio approach in the draft production plan. The engineer's specification has been added to the technical ticket, but it has not yet made it into the greenlight packet, so I want everyone aware of it now before we sign off.
